title: Metadata review center
subtitle: Resolve pending, low-confidence, and failed identifications in one place. Review the virtual-path diff before metadata and file mappings are updated atomically.

recent.title: Recent remaps
recent.subtitle: Undo a recent atomic remap here, provided no later edit has replaced it.
recent.empty: Undoable remaps will appear here after you complete a review.

editor.title: Review metadata
editor.unsetHint: Leave a field blank to clear it. Changing any input after previewing invalidates that preview.

validation.tmdbId: Enter a valid positive-integer TMDB ID.
validation.nonNegativeInteger: Enter a whole number greater than or equal to 0.
validation.groupNameLength: Release group must be 200 characters or fewer.

errors.conflict: This item changed elsewhere. Close the panel, refresh the list, and review it again (409).
errors.validation: The server could not validate this metadata or its paths. Check the input and warnings, then retry (422).
errors.requestFailed: The request failed and no changes were applied. Please try again.

preview.title: Pre-apply preview
preview.noPathChanges: This item has no files to remap; its metadata can still be updated from this preview.
preview.collisionAdjusted: A path collision was detected, so the server adjusted the destination filename.

warningCodes.notDownloaded: The download is incomplete, so only metadata will change and existing file mappings will be preserved.
warningCodes.unresolvedFiles: Some files could not be identified and will use the unknown-file virtual-path rule.

toast.undoConflict: Cannot undo: this item has a newer update (409)
toast.undoValidation: Cannot undo: the former paths cannot be restored (422)

pending.title: Awaiting identification
pending.emptyBody: Every new item is identified or has moved to another review category.

lowConfidence.title: Low-confidence results
lowConfidence.emptyBody: There are no low-confidence identifications awaiting confirmation.

failed.title: Failed identifications
failed.emptyBody: There are no failed identifications or items at their retry limit.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the review queue
errors.loadFailedDetail: The latest review state is unavailable. Check the service connection and retry.
